newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dlr ends little changed, consolidation seen.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dlr ends little changed, consolidation seen.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar inched softer against its U.S. counterpart at Thursday's close, and dealers expected the rate to stay at current levels for the near term.
The local unit ended at T$27.525 against Thursday's T$27.515 close. Turnover through dealers was a brisk US$288.5 million.
Dealers said the market appeared to have reached a near-term equilibrium at the Taiwan dollar's current levels.
"It seems as if all fluctuations end up back at T$27.5," said one dealer. A T$27.49-53 range was seen for Saturday.
